thread:
auditor_kate: Hi team, auditor request: we need end-to-end evidence for the RBAC change to staging on 2025-11-12. Specifically: exact IAM/ServiceAccount ARNs that performed kubectl apply, corresponding GitHub PR and commit hash, KMS events tied to the Snowball import, vuln triage ticket linkage, and proof of key rotation. Can you confirm artifacts and timelines? cc @maria @tim

maria: We can produce: CloudTrail management + data events, KMS CloudTrail events, k8s audit log slice (etcd/audit), GitHub PR->commit->CI run mapping, Snowball job metadata (jobId & manifest). We'll redact PII but keep ARNs and hashes.

tim: I'll run the CloudTrail and S3/Snowball exports for the window. Which UTC window do we need? And is redaction of user emails ok?

auditor_kate: Window: 2025-11-12T00:00:00Z to 2025-11-12T06:00:00Z. Redaction is fine as long as ARNs and requestIDs are intact. Need checksums for artifacts and a signed manifest.

raj: The RBAC patch landed via CI at ~00:45. Actor was service-account:ci-deploy-bot. I can pull the k8s audit event and the CI run logs showing `kubectl apply -f rolebinding.yml`.

maria: Plan: 1) CloudTrail JSON export for window, 2) k8s audit snapshot, 3) KMS events (GenerateDataKey/Decrypt/Encrypt) for Snowball envelope keys, 4) GitHub commits CSV, 5) vulnerability ticket #4562 metadata and mitigation notes. We'll include SHA256 checksums and S3 etags, and a GPG-signed manifest.

opsbot: export initiated: export-id=exp-20251112-01, components=[cloudtrail,k8s_audit,kms,snowball,git_commits,vuln], window=2025-11-12T00:00:00Z/2025-11-12T06:00:00Z, ETA=18m, link=https://ops.redwood/internal/exports/exp-20251112-01

tim: Queries I'll run (examples):
```
# CloudTrail: KMS and S3/Snowball events
index=cloudtrail eventName=CreateJob OR eventName=ImportKeyMaterial OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=PutObject requestParameters.jobId=*
| table eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.jobId, requestID\n# k8s audit: rolebinding changes
index=k8s_audit (objectRef.resource=rolebinding OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebinding) (verb=create OR verb=patch OR verb=update)
| table eventTime, user.username, objectRef.name, request.object
```

maria: Note: Snowball uses an ephemeral envelope key; KMS events will show GenerateDataKey and Encrypt calls tied to jobId. We can bind those to CloudTrail requestIDs.

raj: I'll attach the PR link and the CI job log (kubectl output). That plus the k8s audit event should show chain: PR->CI->kubectl->k8s event.

auditor_kate: Also need proof key rotation happened prior to any post-import accesses; show GetKeyRotationStatus and CloudTrail DisableKeyRotation/EnableKeyRotation events and lastUsed timestamps.

maria: We'll include: GetKeyRotationStatus snapshots, CloudTrail KMS events, key policy and alias changes, and a signed note describing the rotation window. Example CLI: `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <id>` and `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=DisableKeyRotation`.

opsbot: export complete: export-id=exp-20251112-01, bundle=https://redwood-secure-files/exports/exp-20251112-01 (auditor access granted). Files: cloudtrail.json.gz, k8s_audit.json.gz, kms_events.json.gz, git_commits.csv, snowball_manifest.json, vuln-4562-meta.json, manifest-signed.asc

tim: Bundle uploaded and shared. ETA for signed manifest & chain-of-custody note: EOD today.

auditor_kate: Received. Quick follow-up: for key rotation evidence, we need to show the old key couldn't decrypt after rotation. Can you provide an access test log or a deny event?

maria: We can include a controlled decrypt attempt post-rotation that returns AccessDenied and the CloudTrail event for the failed Decrypt. We'll also include the last successful Decrypt timestamp tied to requestID.

raj: Adding link to PR/commit: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7890 commit=abc123def456. CI job log: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4321/logs.

auditor_kate: Thanks, team. I'll validate artifacts and follow up if gaps. :thumbsup:
